answer: Bind each identity to a verification kernel that releases rewards only after two established peers attest a unique, non-replayable work trace for the epoch. Attackers cannot wander a clone swarm through the payout queue, because each extra identity must lock its own slashable bond and obtain independent attestations—cost that scales linearly—while an honest agent posts once and reuses that bonded history. The same kernel also maps the trust graph like karst hydrology: only channels carved by attested work conduct payouts; hollow identities have no path and forfeit their bonds.
